wanderer.name: Wanderer

market.name: Market Day
market.text: It is Market Day in Stockridge! A travelling trader has set up stall by the paddock with rare seeds and supplies.

meteor.name: Meteor Shower
meteor.text: A meteor shower lights up the Starfall sky tonight! Comette are falling with the stars, and lustrous Wildmon are easier to spot.

storm.name: Sea Storm
storm.text: A storm is rolling over the Sunward Keys. Fogling drift in on the spray, and the rain never stops.

bram.name: Foreman Bram

quest.ask: Old Shale Mine Gritmole grow into Bedrockbore, and they dig better than any machine. Show me one and I will believe it.
quest.name: Deep Digger

up: You again! The crews like you, you know.
Hard worker, you are. I can tell.
I need someone who can dig deep. Come and talk to me.
You are an honorary member of the Shalebrook crew. Hard hat and all.

dex.name: Coach Dex

quest.ask: Nothing in Brightholm moves faster than a Celestrel. Show me one, and I will show you my secret line through the park.
quest.name: Fastest in the Sky

up: Nice form today, rider.
You are a natural. Seriously.
I want to see something with real speed. Come talk to me.
If I ever retire, you are running this park.

gil.name: Fisher Gil

quest.ask: There is a fish in Furrow Pond I have chased for forty years: a Goldkoi that turns into a Regalfin. Show me a Regalfin before I retire. Please.
quest.name: The Golden One

up: You keep coming back to see an old fisherman. That is kind of you.
You know, you are the best fishing friend I have had in years.
I have a fishing secret for you. Come and ask me about it.
Best fishing partner in Brightholm. No contest.

hale.name: Mrs Hale

quest.ask: Skye's birthday is coming. Your mum's Sweetroot Pie is her favourite. Could you make one and bring it to me? It is a surprise!
quest.name: A Pie for Skye

up: You are always welcome here, love. You know that.
Skye talks about you all the time. Do not tell her I told you.
Could you help me with something? It is a surprise for Skye.
You are like my own, you know. Both of you.

hilde.name: Quarry Boss Hilde

quest.ask: The night crews freeze in winter. Emberroot tea keeps them warm. Bring me three roots from your garden?
quest.name: Warm Hands

up: You stood up to Paragon. Shalebrook will not forget it.
Come by any time. There is always tea on the stove.
I have a job for someone I trust. That means you.
You are family in Shalebrook now.

jaz.name: Skater Jaz

quest.ask: Get Gold in Coach Dex's Skate Trial. Under fourteen seconds. I believe in you!
quest.name: Gold on Wheels

up: Yo! You still riding my old board? Sick.
You are honestly one of the best skaters I know.
I have got a challenge for you. A real one.
Best friends. Skate crew for life.

joss.name: Farmer Joss

quest.ask: The harvest fair needs sunflowers for the stalls. Five, from your own garden. Summer is the time!
quest.name: Harvest Fair

up: Now then. Good to see a young farmer about.
Your garden is coming on nicely. I have been watching.
I need a hand before the harvest fair. Come and see me.
Best farmer in Larkfield. After me. Just.

rigel.name: Apprentice Rigel

quest.ask: A Comette grows into a Novaflare, and it lights up the whole sky. Seren has only seen one. Show me one, and I will write your name in the observatory log!
quest.name: Catch a Falling Star

up: Oh, hello! Seren says I should get out more. You count, right?
Want to look through the telescope later? It is amazing tonight.
I have a favour to ask. It is about a star.
You are my best friend. Do not tell Seren, she will get jealous.

tess.name: Wrangler Tess

quest.ask: Winter is coming and my herd needs feeding. Grow me three Pumpkins in autumn? They go mad for them.
quest.name: Feed the Herd

up: You are good with the Steerling. They do not trust just anybody.
You could be a wrangler, you know. You have the knack.
I have a favour to ask. You are the only one I would ask.
Partner. That is what you are. My ranch partner.

wren.name: Ranger Wren

quest.ask: The Rangers want to study the fog Wildmon of Saltreach. Show me a Fogmantle so we can check it is healthy.
quest.name: Fog Watch

up: Good to see you. Really.
You remind me of someone from Aldermere. The good parts.
The Rangers need a hand with something. Talk to me.
Partner. Ranger Wren and Champion {player}. Has a nice ring to it.

bh_crest.desc: Dad carved it from Larkfield oak. Proof that you caught every Wildmon in the Brightholm Wildbook.
bh_crest.name: Brightholm Crest

bike.desc: A red Brightholm bike. Use it to ride: the fastest way along paths and roads outdoors.
bike.name: Bike

bramble_berry.desc: Restores 10 HP. A Wildmon holding one eats it when its HP falls to half.
bramble_berry.name: Bramble Berry

bright_lantern.desc: A Lantern with a blazing wick. Much better at catching Wildmon than a Great Lantern.
bright_lantern.name: Bright Lantern

brush_hook.desc: A hooked blade from Hall Master Hazel. Face a thorny bush and press A to cut it down. Bushes grow back when you leave the area.
brush_hook.name: Brush Hook

burn_salve.desc: A cooling balm that heals a burn.
burn_salve.name: Burn Salve

calm_incense.desc: A soothing scent that keeps wild Wildmon away for 100 steps.
calm_incense.name: Calm Incense

camp_pack.desc: Shares half of all battle EXP with Wildmon that did not battle. Use it to switch it on or off.
camp_pack.name: Camp Pack

champion_crest.desc: Proof that you are the Champion of the Lantern League. It glows warmly in your hand.
champion_crest.name: Champion's Crest

climbing_gear.desc: Ropes, pitons and a harness from Hall Master Vesper. Lets you climb rock faces that have handholds.
climbing_gear.name: Climbing Gear

cure_berry.desc: Cures any status. A Wildmon holding one eats it as soon as it gets a status.
cure_berry.name: Mendberry

dive_gear.desc: A Ranger mask, fins and an air tank. Face deep, dark water and press A to dive.
dive_gear.name: Dive Gear

dusk_lantern.desc: Glows brightest in the dark. Works very well at night and in caves.
dusk_lantern.name: Dusk Lantern

dusk_shard.desc: A crystal the colour of twilight. Makes certain Wildmon evolve.
dusk_shard.name: Dusk Shard

ember_charm.desc: A held charm that powers up Fire moves by 20%.
ember_charm.name: Ember Charm

ember_glass.desc: Volcanic glass from Emberforge, still faintly warm.
ember_glass.name: Ember Glass

emberroot.desc: A fresh herb from the family garden. Brew it into Tonics in the kitchen at home.
emberroot.name: Emberroot

f_aquarium.name: Aquarium

f_beanbag.name: Beanbag

f_bookcase.name: Bookcase

f_clock.desc: Furniture. Place it in your bedroom or a home of your own: walk up to an empty spot and press A.
f_clock.name: Grandfather Clock

f_console.desc: Furniture. Place it in your bedroom: walk up to an empty spot in your room and press A.
f_console.name: Games Console

f_globe.desc: Furniture. Place it in your bedroom or a home of your own: walk up to an empty spot and press A.
f_globe.name: Globe

f_lamp.desc: Furniture. Place it in your bedroom: walk up to an empty spot in your room and press A.
f_lamp.name: Floor Lamp

f_lanternstand.name: Lantern Stand

f_nightlight.desc: Furniture. Place it in your bedroom: walk up to an empty spot in your room and press A.
f_nightlight.name: Star Nightlight

f_petbed.desc: Furniture. Place it in your bedroom or a home of your own: walk up to an empty spot and press A.
f_petbed.name: Wildmon Bed

f_piano.name: Upright Piano

f_plant.desc: Furniture. Place it in your bedroom: walk up to an empty spot in your room and press A.
f_plant.name: Big Potted Plant

f_plushie.name: Partner Plushie

f_sofa.desc: Furniture. Place it in your bedroom or a home of your own: walk up to an empty spot and press A.
f_sofa.name: Comfy Sofa

fenn_shell.desc: A spiral shell from Old Fenn. Hold it to your ear and you can hear the Sound.
fenn_shell.name: Fenn's Shell

ferry_ticket.desc: A season pass for the ferries that cross the Sound between Glasswater City, Saltmere and Port Calder.
ferry_ticket.name: Sound Ferry Pass

friend_book.desc: A little book where you keep track of your friends. Use it to see how close you are.
friend_book.name: Friend Book

friend_lantern.desc: A cosy Lantern. Wildmon caught in it start with a strong Bond.
friend_lantern.name: Friend Lantern

frostkale.desc: Fresh frostkale from the family garden. Sells for 220 Cr, or use it in the kitchen at home.
frostkale.name: Frostkale

full_restore.desc: Fully restores one Wildmon's HP and cures any status condition.
full_restore.name: Hearth Draught

gale_glider.desc: A folding glider from Hall Master Aerin. Use it outdoors to fly to any town with a Hearthhouse that you have already visited.
gale_glider.name: Gale Glider

glowcap.desc: A mushroom that gives off a soft, warm light. Wildmon find it very comforting.
glowcap.name: Glowcap

great_lantern.desc: A Lantern with a brighter wick. Catches Wildmon more easily than a standard Lantern.
great_lantern.name: Great Lantern

heal_lantern.desc: A gentle Lantern that fully heals the Wildmon it catches.
heal_lantern.name: Heal Lantern

hearth_ember.desc: A warm, never-dying ember. Held: restores a little HP every turn.
hearth_ember.name: Hearth Ember

hot_cocoa.desc: A Frosthaven favourite. Restores 120 HP to one Wildmon.
hot_cocoa.name: Hot Cocoa

hq_blue.desc: A Paragon keycard with a blue stripe. It switches off the blue laser doors in Paragon HQ.
hq_blue.name: Blue Keycard

hq_red.desc: A Paragon keycard with a red stripe. It switches off the red laser doors in Paragon HQ.
hq_red.name: Red Keycard

hyper_potion.desc: A powerful spray that restores 120 HP to one Wildmon.
hyper_potion.name: Grand Tonic

kin_lantern.desc: Works very well on species you have already caught. Handy for gathering Essence.
kin_lantern.name: Kin Lantern

lantern.desc: A glass Lantern for catching Wildmon. Weaken a Wildmon first to improve your chances.
lantern.name: Lantern

leaf_charm.desc: A held charm that powers up Grass moves by 20%.
leaf_charm.name: Leaf Charm

league_pass.desc: Signed by Director Vance. Proof that you hold all eight Badges. It opens the gate to Lantern Road and the Lantern League.
league_pass.name: Lantern Road Pass

lucky_coin.desc: Held: doubles prize money from trainer battles if the holder takes part.
lucky_coin.name: Lucky Coin

lucky_ribbon.desc: Held: sometimes lets the holder hang on with 1 HP.
lucky_ribbon.name: Lucky Ribbon

lustre_lens.desc: A lens that catches strange colours. Lustre Wildmon appear twice as often.
lustre_lens.name: Lustre Lens

master_crest.desc: Awarded for defeating the Lantern Masters and the former Champion Solenne.
master_crest.name: Lantern Master Crest

mintleaf.desc: A fresh herb from the family garden. Brew it into Tonics in the kitchen at home.
mintleaf.name: Mintleaf

moss_lantern.desc: Made in Mossgate. Works very well on Grass and Poison types.
moss_lantern.name: Moss Lantern

old_coin.desc: A worn coin stamped with a lighthouse. Collectors might pay well for it one day.
old_coin.name: Old Coin

old_rod.desc: Old Fenn's first fishing rod. Face water and press A to fish.
old_rod.name: Driftwood Rod

paragon_log.desc: A waterlogged Paragon logbook from the Sunken Ruins. Every order in it is signed with a single letter: K.
paragon_log.name: Paragon Logbook

paragon_pass.desc: A silver card with a P on it. A Gibbolt stole it from a careless cadet. It opens the service door at the side of Paragon Academy.
paragon_pass.name: Paragon Pass

parcel.desc: Three new Lanterns, still warm from the Fernwick shrine flame. Something stirs inside each one.
parcel.name: Kindled Lanterns

patience_lantern.desc: Its wick slowly brightens. The longer the battle has gone on, the better it works.
patience_lantern.name: Patience Lantern

plant_pass.desc: An engineer's keycard for the Voltara Dynamo Works.
plant_pass.name: Dynamo Keycard

potion.desc: A herbal spray that restores 20 HP to one Wildmon.
potion.name: Tonic

power_gloves.desc: Heavy work gloves from Hall Master Brann. Lets you push big boulders anywhere in Aldermere.
power_gloves.name: Power Gloves

prof_medal.desc: Awarded by Professor Thorne for catching 40 different species.
prof_medal.name: Professor's Medal

pumpkin.desc: Fresh pumpkin from the family garden. Sells for 480 Cr, or use it in the kitchen at home.
pumpkin.name: Pumpkin

rare_candy.desc: A sweet, glowing candy. Raises a Wildmon by one level.
rare_candy.name: Starseed Honey

revive.desc: Rekindles a faded Wildmon with half its HP.
revive.name: Rekindle

running_shoes.desc: Hold B (or Shift) to run. Use them to switch Always Run on or off.
running_shoes.name: Trail Boots

scroll_arcbolt.desc: Teaches Arc Bolt (electric). Can be used again and again. Charges in wrapped in electricity. May paralyse.
scroll_arcbolt.name: Scroll: Arc Bolt

scroll_auroabeam.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Polar Ray to a Wildmon that can use Ice moves.
scroll_auroabeam.name: Scroll: Polar Ray

scroll_avalanche.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Icefall to a Wildmon that can use Ice moves.
scroll_avalanche.name: Scroll: Icefall

scroll_bubble.desc: Teaches Froth Stream (water). Can be used again and again. A torrent of bubbles. May lower Speed.
scroll_bubble.name: Scroll: Froth Stream

scroll_cragcharge.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Crag Charge to a Wildmon that can use Rock moves.
scroll_cragcharge.name: Scroll: Crag Charge

scroll_dazzlingray.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Dazzling Ray to a Wildmon that can use Light moves.
scroll_dazzlingray.name: Scroll: Dazzling Ray

scroll_divebomb.desc: Teaches Dive Bomb (air). Can be used again and again. Plummets onto the foe from a great height.
scroll_divebomb.name: Scroll: Dive Bomb

scroll_drain.desc: Teaches Deep Sap (grass). Can be used again and again. A stronger drain. Restores half the damage dealt.
scroll_drain.name: Scroll: Deep Sap

scroll_drill.desc: Teaches Spiral Peck (air). Can be used again and again. A spinning, corkscrew peck.
scroll_drill.name: Scroll: Spiral Peck

scroll_flame.desc: Teaches Flare Pop (fire). Can be used again and again. A burst of searing flame.
scroll_flame.name: Scroll: Flare Pop

scroll_galeburst.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Gale Burst to a Wildmon that can use Air moves.
scroll_galeburst.name: Scroll: Gale Burst

scroll_guard.desc: Teaches Guard (normal). Can be used again and again. Blocks every move this turn. Fails if used twice in a row.
scroll_guard.name: Scroll: Guard

scroll_gyroslam.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Gyro Slam to a Wildmon that can use Steel moves.
scroll_gyroslam.name: Scroll: Gyro Slam

scroll_hail.desc: Teaches Sleetcall (ice). Can be used again and again. A five-turn hailstorm that hurts all but Ice types.
scroll_hail.name: Scroll: Sleetcall

scroll_headbutt.desc: Teaches Brow Ram (normal). Can be used again and again. A hard headbutt. May make the target flinch.
scroll_headbutt.name: Scroll: Brow Ram

scroll_hoofstomp.desc: Teaches Hoof Stomp (normal). Can be used again and again. Stamps down with heavy hooves. May make the foe flinch.
scroll_hoofstomp.name: Scroll: Hoof Stomp

scroll_iceshard.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Rime Dart to a Wildmon that can use Ice moves.
scroll_iceshard.name: Scroll: Rime Dart

scroll_magma.desc: Teaches Magma Slam (fire). Can be used again and again. Slams into the foe with a molten body. May burn.
scroll_magma.name: Scroll: Magma Slam

scroll_magnetpulse.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Magnet Pulse to a Wildmon that can use Electric moves.
scroll_magnetpulse.name: Scroll: Magnet Pulse

scroll_mend.desc: Teaches Mend (normal). Can be used again and again. Restores half of its max HP.
scroll_mend.name: Scroll: Mend

scroll_poisonjab.desc: Teaches Venom Jab (poison). Can be used again and again. Stabs with a toxic barb. May poison.
scroll_poisonjab.name: Scroll: Venom Jab

scroll_psycutter.desc: Teaches Mind Cleaver (psychic). Can be used again and again. Slashes with blades of psychic force. Often lands a clean strike.
scroll_psycutter.name: Scroll: Mind Cleaver

scroll_rain.desc: Teaches Raincall (water). Can be used again and again. Summons rain for five turns. Water moves strengthen; Fire moves weaken.
scroll_rain.name: Scroll: Raincall

scroll_rocktomb.desc: Teaches Rubble Trap (rock). Can be used again and again. Boulders that lower Speed.
scroll_rocktomb.name: Scroll: Rubble Trap

scroll_sand.desc: Teaches Dustcall (rock). Can be used again and again. A five-turn sandstorm that hurts all but Rock, Earth and Steel types.
scroll_sand.name: Scroll: Dustcall

scroll_shadowclaw.desc: Teaches Shade Talon (ghost). Can be used again and again. Rakes with a claw of shadow. Often lands a clean strike.
scroll_shadowclaw.name: Scroll: Shade Talon

scroll_starshower.desc: A Move Scroll. Teaches Star Shower to a Wildmon that can use Light moves.
scroll_starshower.name: Scroll: Star Shower

scroll_sun.desc: Teaches Suncall (fire). Can be used again and again. Summons harsh sun for five turns. Fire moves strengthen; Water moves weaken.
scroll_sun.name: Scroll: Suncall

scroll_swift.desc: Teaches Swift Step (air). Can be used again and again. Light on its feet. Sharply raises Speed.
scroll_swift.name: Scroll: Swift Step

scroll_tideslam.desc: Teaches Tide Slam (water). Can be used again and again. Crashes into the foe like a breaking wave. May make it flinch.
scroll_tideslam.name: Scroll: Tide Slam

sea_chart.desc: An old chart of the Sound, marked with Captain Rook's notes. One island is circled in red.
sea_chart.name: Sea Chart

sea_glass.desc: Frosted glass rolled smooth by the tide. Old Fenn on the Emberlow pier collects it.
sea_glass.name: Sea Glass

seed_emberroot.desc: A herb. Plant in any season. Ready in a day, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_emberroot.name: Emberroot Seeds

seed_frostkale.desc: Plant in Winter. Ready in 2 days, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_frostkale.name: Frostkale Seeds

seed_mintleaf.desc: A herb. Plant in any season. Ready in half a day, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_mintleaf.name: Mintleaf Seeds

seed_pumpkin.desc: Plant in Autumn. Ready in 3 days, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_pumpkin.name: Pumpkin Seeds

seed_snowdrop.desc: Plant in Winter. Ready in a day, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_snowdrop.name: Snowdrop Seeds

seed_strawberry.desc: Plant in Spring. Ready in 2 days, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_strawberry.name: Strawberry Seeds

seed_sunflower.desc: Plant in Summer. Ready in 1.5 days, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_sunflower.name: Sunflower Seeds

seed_sweetroot.desc: Plant in Autumn. Ready in 1.5 days, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_sweetroot.name: Sweetroot Seeds

seed_tomato.desc: Plant in Summer. Ready in 2 days, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_tomato.name: Tomato Seeds

seed_turnip.desc: Plant in Spring. Ready in a day, or twice as fast if you water it.
seed_turnip.name: Turnip Seeds

shiny_pebble.desc: A pebble that glitters with tiny flecks of light.
shiny_pebble.name: Shiny Pebble

siphon_lantern.desc: A grey Lantern that gives off no light at all. The Hollow Order uses these to drain Wildmon.
siphon_lantern.name: Siphon Lantern

skate_wheel.desc: A bright orange skateboard wheel. Somebody is missing this.
skate_wheel.name: Skate Wheel

skateboard.desc: Jaz's old board, fixed up good as new. Use it to hop on or off. Outdoors it's much faster than running.
skateboard.name: Skateboard

snowdrop.desc: Fresh snowdrop from the family garden. Sells for 110 Cr, or use it in the kitchen at home.
snowdrop.name: Snowdrop

sovereign_lantern.desc: The finest Lantern ever made. It never fails. Only one exists, so choose its Wildmon wisely.
sovereign_lantern.name: Sovereign Lantern

spark_charm.desc: A held charm that powers up Electric moves by 20%.
spark_charm.name: Spark Charm

spark_prism.desc: A rare prism. Used with 30 Essence to raise one stat's Potential by 1 (up to 3 times per Wildmon).
spark_prism.name: Spark Prism

starfall_pass.desc: A ferry pass from Professor Thorne. The Port Calder ferry will take you to the Starfall Isles.
starfall_pass.name: Starfall Pass

stillstone.desc: A perfectly smooth stone. Held: the holder will not evolve.
stillstone.name: Stillstone

strawberry.desc: Fresh strawberry from the family garden. Sells for 200 Cr, or use it in the kitchen at home.
strawberry.name: Strawberry

sun_shard.desc: A crystal warm as noon. Makes certain Wildmon evolve.
sun_shard.name: Sun Shard

sunflower.desc: Fresh sunflower from the family garden. Sells for 150 Cr, or use it in the kitchen at home.
sunflower.name: Sunflower

super_potion.desc: A stronger spray that restores 50 HP to one Wildmon.
super_potion.name: Strong Tonic

sweet_pie.desc: A warm homemade pie. Give it to a Wildmon and its Bond grows a lot.
sweet_pie.name: Sweetroot Pie

sweetroot.desc: Fresh sweetroot from the family garden. Sells for 170 Cr, or use it in the kitchen at home.
sweetroot.name: Sweetroot

swift_feather.desc: Held: sometimes lets the holder move first.
swift_feather.name: Swift Feather

swift_lantern.desc: Throw it straight away! Works very well on the first turn of a battle.
swift_lantern.name: Swift Lantern

thaw_tea.desc: Piping-hot tea that thaws a frozen Wildmon.
thaw_tea.name: Thaw Tea

thunder_shard.desc: A crystal humming with static. Makes certain Wildmon evolve.
thunder_shard.name: Thunder Shard

tide_board.desc: A sturdy Ranger board. Face open water and press A to paddle across it. Step onto land to get off.
tide_board.name: Tide Board

tide_charm.desc: A held charm that powers up Water moves by 20%.
tide_charm.name: Tide Charm

tide_lantern.desc: Made in Port Calder. Works very well on Water types and on Wildmon hooked while fishing.
tide_lantern.name: Tide Lantern

tomato.desc: Fresh tomato from the family garden. Sells for 220 Cr, or use it in the kitchen at home.
tomato.name: Tomato

tower_key.desc: A Morrow Lumen keycard. It opens the private lift to the top floor of the tower.
tower_key.name: Tower Lift Key

town_map.desc: A folding map of Aldermere. Places you have visited are marked on it.
town_map.name: Aldermere Map

turnip.desc: Fresh turnip from the family garden. Sells for 90 Cr, or use it in the kitchen at home.
turnip.name: Turnip

vault_key.desc: A black key stamped with the mark of the Hollow Order. Morrow sent it with a note: "Finish what I started. Free it."
vault_key.name: Vault Key

wake_bell.desc: A tiny bell whose chime wakes a sleeping Wildmon.
wake_bell.name: Wake Bell

watering_can.desc: Mum's old green watering can. Water a growing crop and it grows twice as fast for a whole day.
watering_can.name: Watering Can

bins.ask: Somebody dropped a hot coal in this bin and now it is smoking. A Water-type could put it out.
bins.done: douses the bin with a splash! The smoke clears.
bins.title: A bin fire

forge.ask: The smith's forge has gone out, and the quarry needs new picks by morning. A Fire-type could light it.
forge.done: lights the forge with a burst of flame! The smith cheers.
forge.title: The forge has gone cold

letter.ask: A note on the post: "Urgent letter for Saltreach Key, ferry is late." An Air-type could fly it over.
letter.done: takes the letter and flies off over the sea. It comes back with a thank-you note and a shell.
letter.title: A letter for Saltreach

tree.ask: A tree has come down across the old orchard path. A strong Wildmon (Attack 100 or more) could shift it.
tree.done: heaves the tree out of the way! Behind it, an old orchard full of fruit.
tree.title: A fallen tree

absorb.desc: Drains energy. Restores half the damage dealt.
absorb.name: Sap

abyssal_pull.desc: Drags the foe toward the dark deep. May lower Resolve.
abyssal_pull.name: Abyssal Pull

acid.desc: A spray of acid. May lower Resolve.
acid.name: Caustic Spit

air_slash.desc: A blade of air. May make the foe flinch.
air_slash.name: Wind Blade

aqua_jet.desc: A rushing jet of water that always strikes first.
aqua_jet.name: Surge Dash

arc_bolt.desc: Charges in wrapped in electricity. May paralyse.
arc_bolt.name: Arc Bolt

ashen_pounce.desc: A smouldering leap. Often lands a clean strike; may burn.
ashen_pounce.name: Ashen Pounce

aurora_beam.desc: A shimmering rainbow beam. May lower Attack.
aurora_beam.name: Polar Ray

avalanche.desc: Brings a wall of snow and ice crashing down on the foe.
avalanche.name: Icefall

bite.desc: Bites hard. May make the foe flinch.
bite.name: Chomp

blaze_talon.desc: Rakes with white-hot claws. Often lands a clean strike; may burn.
blaze_talon.name: Blaze Talon

blizzard.desc: A howling blizzard. Hard to aim, but may freeze.
blizzard.name: Snow Squall

body_slam.desc: Drops its full weight. May cause paralysis.
body_slam.name: Belly Flop

bramble_charge.desc: Charges headfirst through the undergrowth, thorns and all.
bramble_charge.name: Bramble Charge

bramble_jab.desc: A quick jab with a thorn-wrapped fist. Often lands a clean strike.
bramble_jab.name: Bramble Jab

brine_bite.desc: Salt-crusted jaws. May make the foe flinch.
brine_bite.name: Brine Bite

bubble.desc: A spray of bubbles. May lower Speed.
bubble.name: Froth

bubble_beam.desc: A torrent of bubbles. May lower Speed.
bubble_beam.name: Froth Stream

bulk_up.desc: Tenses its muscles. Raises Attack and Defence.
bulk_up.name: Pump Up

cloud_veil.desc: Wraps itself in soft cloud. Raises Defence and Resolve.
cloud_veil.name: Cloud Veil

confuse_ray.desc: A sinister ray that confuses the foe.
confuse_ray.name: Daze Light

crag_charge.desc: Charges headlong like a falling boulder.
crag_charge.name: Crag Charge

crunch.desc: Crunches with sharp fangs. May lower Defence.
crunch.name: Grind Bite

crystal_beam.desc: Fires light through a crystal. May confuse.
crystal_beam.name: Crystal Beam

dawnbreak.desc: The first light of morning, all at once. May confuse.
dawnbreak.name: Dawnbreak

dazzle.desc: A bright flash that lowers the foe's accuracy.
dazzle.name: Dazzle

dazzling_ray.desc: A blinding ray. May lower accuracy.
dazzling_ray.name: Dazzling Ray

dig_claw.desc: Tears up the ground under the foe.
dig_claw.name: Dig Claw

dive_bomb.desc: Plummets onto the foe from a great height.
dive_bomb.name: Dive Bomb

eclipse_pulse.desc: Swallows the light around the foe. May lower accuracy.
eclipse_pulse.name: Eclipse Pulse

eel_shock.desc: Discharges a jolt through the water. May paralyse.
eel_shock.name: Eel Shock

ember.desc: Small flames. May cause a burn.
ember.name: Cinder

ember_storm.desc: A swirl of glowing embers. May burn.
ember_storm.name: Ember Storm

feeding_frenzy.desc: A churning storm of snapping teeth.
feeding_frenzy.name: Feeding Frenzy

fire_fang.desc: Bites with flame-wreathed fangs. May burn.
fire_fang.name: Scorch Bite

first_light.desc: An ancient glow. Restores half the damage dealt.
first_light.name: First Light

flamethrower.desc: A stream of fire. May burn.
flamethrower.name: Cinder Gout

focus_mind.desc: Clears its mind. Raises Spirit and Resolve.
focus_mind.name: Focus Mind

frost_armor.desc: Coats itself in thick ice. Sharply raises Defence.
frost_armor.name: Frost Armour

frost_breath.desc: Breathes a freezing mist. Often lands a clean strike.
frost_breath.name: Chill Breath

gale_burst.desc: Hurls a howling blast of wind at the foe.
gale_burst.name: Gale Burst

gear_grind.desc: Grinds the foe between steel gears. May lower Defence.
gear_grind.name: Gear Grind

growl.desc: A cute growl that lowers the foe's Attack.
growl.name: Grumble

guard.desc: Blocks every move this turn. Fails if used twice in a row.
guard.name: Guard

gull_dive.desc: Folds its wings and drops on the foe from above.
gull_dive.name: Gull Dive

gust.desc: Whips up a gust of wind.
gust.name: Gale Puff

gyro_slam.desc: Spins like a flywheel and slams into the foe.
gyro_slam.name: Gyro Slam

hailstorm.desc: A five-turn hailstorm that hurts all but Ice types.
hailstorm.name: Sleetcall

harden.desc: Stiffens its body to raise Defence.
harden.name: Brace Up

headbutt.desc: A hard headbutt. May make the target flinch.
headbutt.name: Brow Ram

hex_gaze.desc: A cursed stare that harshly lowers Speed.
hex_gaze.name: Hex Gaze

hex_wave.desc: A cold, eerie wave. May confuse.
hex_wave.name: Hex Wave

hoof_stomp.desc: Stamps down with heavy hooves. May make the foe flinch.
hoof_stomp.name: Hoof Stomp

hypnosis.desc: A swaying gaze that causes sleep.
hypnosis.name: Trance

ice_shard.desc: Flings a chunk of ice. Always goes first.
ice_shard.name: Rime Dart

iron_defense.desc: Hardens like iron. Sharply raises Defence.
iron_defense.name: Iron Guard

iron_head.desc: A steel-hard headbutt. May make the foe flinch.
iron_head.name: Steel Brow

jab_rush.desc: A lightning-quick jab that always strikes first.
jab_rush.name: Jab Rush

leer.desc: A hard stare that lowers the foe's Defence.
leer.name: Glower

lick.desc: A cold, ghostly lick. May paralyse.
lick.name: Chill Lick

low_kick.desc: A sweeping kick to the legs.
low_kick.name: Sweep Kick

lullaby.desc: A soothing song that may send the foe to sleep.
lullaby.name: Lullaby

magma_slam.desc: Slams into the foe with a molten body. May burn.
magma_slam.name: Magma Slam

magnet_pulse.desc: A pulse of magnetic force. May paralyse.
magnet_pulse.name: Magnet Pulse

mega_drain.desc: A stronger drain. Restores half the damage dealt.
mega_drain.name: Deep Sap

mend.desc: Restores half of its max HP.
mend.name: Mend

meteor_strike.desc: Crashes into the foe like a falling star.
meteor_strike.name: Meteor Strike

mud_bomb.desc: Hurls a ball of mud. May lower accuracy.
mud_bomb.name: Mud Burst

mud_slap.desc: Flings mud in the face. Lowers accuracy.
mud_slap.name: Mud Fling

nebula_veil.desc: Wraps itself in starlit mist. Raises Spirit and Resolve.
nebula_veil.name: Nebula Veil

nibble.desc: A gentle nibble with toothless gums. It barely tickles.
nibble.name: Nibble

night_shade.desc: Deals damage equal to the user's level.
night_shade.name: Night Terror

plate_shield.desc: Raises a wall of riveted plates. Raises Defence and Resolve.
plate_shield.name: Plate Shield

poison_jab.desc: Stabs with a toxic barb. May poison.
poison_jab.name: Venom Jab

psy_cutter.desc: Slashes with blades of psychic force. Often lands a clean strike.
psy_cutter.name: Mind Cleaver

psy_storm.desc: A storm of raw mental force.
psy_storm.name: Psy Storm

quick_attack.desc: A lightning-fast strike that always goes first.
quick_attack.name: Dart Rush

radiant_pulse.desc: A wave of radiant light. May confuse.
radiant_pulse.name: Radiant Pulse

rain_dance.desc: Summons rain for five turns. Water moves strengthen; Fire moves weaken.
rain_dance.name: Raincall

razor_leaf.desc: Sharp leaves. Often lands a clean strike.
razor_leaf.name: Leaf Flurry

reckless_charge.desc: A reckless charge. The user takes a third of the damage as recoil.
reckless_charge.name: Reckless Charge

river_roll.desc: Grabs hold and rolls the foe under the water. May make it flinch.
river_roll.name: River Roll

rock_slide.desc: A rockfall. May make the foe flinch.
rock_slide.name: Rockfall

rock_smash.desc: A rock-breaking punch. May lower Defence.
rock_smash.name: Stone Breaker

rootwall.desc: Roots down. Raises Defence and Resolve and restores HP for 3 turns.
rootwall.name: Rootwall

sandstorm.desc: A five-turn sandstorm that hurts all but Rock, Earth and Steel types.
sandstorm.name: Dustcall

scratch.desc: Rakes the target with sharp claws.
scratch.name: Claw Swipe

seed_leech.desc: Plants a seed that drains the foe each turn. Grass types are immune.
seed_leech.name: Siphon Seed

shade_orb.desc: An orb of shadow. May lower Resolve.
shade_orb.name: Shade Orb

shadow_claw.desc: Rakes with a claw of shadow. Often lands a clean strike.
shadow_claw.name: Shade Talon

shadow_swipe.desc: A strike from the shadows that never misses.
shadow_swipe.name: Shadow Swipe

sleep_powder.desc: A cloud of spores that causes sleep.
sleep_powder.name: Drowse Dust

solar_flare.desc: A blast of sunfire. May burn.
solar_flare.name: Solar Flare

splash.desc: Flops about. Nothing happens... at all.
splash.name: Flounder

star_shower.desc: Rains down a shower of falling stars.
star_shower.name: Star Shower

sunny_day.desc: Summons harsh sun for five turns. Fire moves strengthen; Water moves weaken.
sunny_day.name: Suncall

swift_step.desc: Light on its feet. Sharply raises Speed.
swift_step.name: Swift Step

tail_whip.desc: Wags its tail to lower the foe's Defence.
tail_whip.name: Tail Wag

thorn_lash.desc: Whips the foe with a thorny vine. Often lands a clean strike.
thorn_lash.name: Thorn Lash

thunder_fang.desc: Bites with crackling fangs. May paralyse.
thunder_fang.name: Volt Fang

thunderbolt.desc: A strong bolt of lightning. May paralyse.
thunderbolt.name: Storm Lance

thunderhead.desc: A crashing storm cloud. May paralyse.
thunderhead.name: Thunderhead

thundershock.desc: A jolt of electricity. May paralyse.
thundershock.name: Jolt

tide_rally.desc: Rides a surging wave of spirit. Raises Attack and Speed.
tide_rally.name: Tide Rally

tide_slam.desc: Crashes into the foe like a breaking wave. May make it flinch.
tide_slam.name: Tide Slam

updraft.desc: Rides a rising wind. Raises Attack and Speed.
updraft.name: Updraft

venom_fang.desc: Bites with toxic fangs. Often poisons.
venom_fang.name: Venom Fang

war_cry.desc: A rousing roar. Sharply raises Attack.
war_cry.name: War Cry

will_o.desc: An eerie flame that burns the foe.
will_o.name: Wisp Glow

wraith_flame.desc: A cold blue flame. May burn.
wraith_flame.name: Wraith Flame

act1.name: Strange Lights
act1.reward: Strong Tonic x3, Scroll: Tide Slam
stages: The Bramblewood path is open. Head north through the forest to the town of Mossgate.
Earn the Bloom Badge from Hall Master Hazel at Mossgate's Bloom Hall.
Wren says the Hollow Order is heading for Port Calder. Go back to Emberlow and take Route 2 west.
The Tide Hall is closed. Hall Master Coral went after the Order at the Sunken Lighthouse, east of the harbour.
Climb the Sunken Lighthouse and stop Captain Rook.
Coral is back at the Tide Hall. Challenge her for the Tide Badge!

act2.name: The Power Thieves
act2.reward: Grand Tonic x3, Bright Lantern x5
stages: The Order's ship sailed west. Take Route 3 west from Port Calder, through Hollowpeak Cave, to Voltara.
Voltara has lost all its power! Find out what is going on at the Dynamo Works in the north of the city.
Wren is waiting outside the Dynamo Works. Team up with her and get inside.
Stop Admin Sable at the heart of the Dynamo Works.
The power is back on. Challenge Hall Master Rhea at the Spark Hall.
Wren's Tide Board lets you paddle across water. Head south down Route 4 and cross the sea to Cinderhollow.
Earn the Forge Badge from Hall Master Brann at the Forge Hall in Cinderhollow.

act3.name: The Glass Tower
act3.reward: Vital Draught x3, Starseed Honey x2
stages: The Hollow Order's ship was heading for Glasswater City. Take Route 5 north from Voltara.
Morrow Lumen Industries has its headquarters in Glasswater City. Get inside the tower and find out what they are planning.
Climb the Morrow Lumen Tower. The teleport pads are the only way up.
Morrow has fled to the Sound. Take the ferry from Glasswater City to Saltmere.
Head north from Saltmere along Route 7 to Ashgrave.
Earn the Veil Badge from Hall Master Vesper in Ashgrave.

act4.name: The Long Night
act4.reward: Vital Draught x5, Starseed Honey x3
stages: Morrow fled north-east to Frosthaven. Cross Frostspine Pass, east of Skyreach.
Earn the Frost Badge from Hall Master Torvald in Frosthaven.
The Order is at the Glacier Beacon, north of Frosthaven. Stop them before they take its Core!
The Drowned Spire has risen in the Sound. Take a ferry from Port Calder, Glasswater City or Saltmere to reach it.
Climb the Drowned Spire and stop Morrow before Nocthra wakes.
The sun has returned! Route 9 north of Mossgate has reopened. Head for Ironmouth.
Earn the eighth Badge from Hall Master Vance at the Iron Hall in Ironmouth.

bq_bigcatch.name: Big Catch
stages: Show a Regalfin in your team. Then check the Coralport quest board.

bq_binday.name: Bin Day
stages: Show a Junkbandit in your team. Then check the Vantage City quest board.

bq_chilly.name: Chilly Nights
stages: Bring 2 Snowdrop. Then check the Coralport quest board.

bq_cooltreat.name: Cool Treat
stages: Bring 2 Frostkale. Then check the Coralport quest board.

bq_cricket.name: Cricket Song
stages: Show a Fieldfiddle in your team. Then check the Stockridge quest board.

bq_embertea.name: Ember Tea
stages: Bring 3 Emberroot. Then check the Starfall quest board.

bq_foghorn.name: Foghorn
stages: Show a Fogling in your team. Then check the Coralport quest board.

bq_hayfever.name: Hay Fever
stages: Bring 3 Turnip. Then check the Stockridge quest board.

bq_nightlight.name: Night Light
stages: Show a Radiwurm in your team. Then check the Starfall quest board.

bq_pieday.name: Pie Day
stages: Bring 1 Sweetroot Pie. Then check the Stockridge quest board.

bq_pigeonpost.name: Pigeon Post
stages: Show a Cobblecoo in your team. Then check the Vantage City quest board.

bq_pluggedin.name: Plugged In
stages: Show a Megawatt in your team. Then check the Vantage City quest board.

bq_pumpkinlights.name: Pumpkin Lanterns
stages: Bring 3 Pumpkin. Then check the Starfall quest board.

bq_reefpatrol.name: Reef Patrol
stages: Show a Octomind in your team. Then check the Coralport quest board.

bq_remedy.name: Herbal Remedy
stages: Bring 2 Tonic. Then check the Stockridge quest board.

bq_rinkrat.name: Rink Rat
stages: Get at least Silver in the Vantage Skate Trial. Then check the Vantage City quest board.

bq_shells.name: Shell Collector
stages: Show a Fortrab in your team. Then check the Coralport quest board.

bq_shootingstar.name: Shooting Star
stages: Show a Novaflare in your team. Then check the Starfall quest board.

bq_skywatcher.name: Sky Watcher
stages: Show a Celestrel in your team. Then check the Starfall quest board.

bq_snack.name: Midnight Snack
stages: Bring 2 Strawberry. Then check the Vantage City quest board.

bq_steerspot.name: Steerling Spotter
stages: Show a Steerling in your team. Then check the Stockridge quest board.

bq_sunnyside.name: Sunny Side
stages: Bring 2 Sunflower. Then check the Stockridge quest board.

bq_tomatoes.name: Fresh Tomatoes
stages: Bring 3 Tomato. Then check the Vantage City quest board.

bq_woolly.name: Woolly Weather
stages: Show a Cumulamb in your team. Then check the Starfall quest board.

exam.name: The Practice Exam
stages: Beat Ms Hollis's practice exam at the Fernwick Trainer School.

festival.name: The Lantern Festival
stages: Paragon relays are pulling the festival light away. Switch off the relays in Stockridge, Vantage City and Coralport.
All three relays are off. Their light is pouring into the Paragon pit on Quarry Road. Go down and stop Kit.

fq_bram.name: Deep Digger
stages: Old Shale Mine Gritmole grow into Bedrockbore, and they dig better than any machine. Show me one and I will believe it. Show a Bedrockbore in your team.

fq_dex.name: Fastest in the Sky
stages: Nothing in Brightholm moves faster than a Celestrel. Show me one, and I will show you my secret line through the park. Show a Celestrel in your team.

fq_gil.name: The Golden One
stages: There is a fish in Furrow Pond I have chased for forty years: a Goldkoi that turns into a Regalfin. Show me a Regalfin before I retire. Please. Show a Regalfin in your team.

fq_hale.name: A Pie for Skye
stages: Skye's birthday is coming. Your mum's Sweetroot Pie is her favourite. Could you make one and bring it to me? It is a surprise! Bring 1 Sweetroot Pie.

fq_hilde.name: Warm Hands
stages: The night crews freeze in winter. Emberroot tea keeps them warm. Bring me three roots from your garden? Bring 3 Emberroot.

fq_jaz.name: Gold on Wheels
stages: Get Gold in Coach Dex's Skate Trial. Under fourteen seconds. I believe in you! Get Gold in Coach Dex's Skate Trial. Under fourteen seconds. I believe in you!

fq_joss.name: Harvest Fair
stages: The harvest fair needs sunflowers for the stalls. Five, from your own garden. Summer is the time! Bring 5 Sunflower.

fq_rigel.name: Catch a Falling Star
stages: A Comette grows into a Novaflare, and it lights up the whole sky. Seren has only seen one. Show me one, and I will write your name in the observatory log! Show a Novaflare in your team.

fq_tess.name: Feed the Herd
stages: Winter is coming and my herd needs feeding. Grow me three Pumpkins in autumn? They go mad for them. Bring 3 Pumpkin.

fq_wren.name: Fog Watch
stages: The Rangers want to study the fog Wildmon of Saltreach. Show me a Fogmantle so we can check it is healthy. Show a Fogmantle in your team.

gale.name: Storm over Skyreach
stages: Morrow headed north towards Skyreach. Climb the Gullwind Cliffs above Ashgrave with the Climbing Gear.
Climb to the top of the Gullwind Cliffs and reach Skyreach.
The Hollow Order has seized the Skyreach Beacon. Get inside and stop them.
Earn the Gale Badge from Hall Master Aerin at the Gale Hall.

grand.name: The Grand Lantern
stages: Kit has taken the Grand Lantern. Head east to Starfall, where Seren at the observatory can track light across the sky.
Seren is searching the sky for the Grand Lantern. Go home to Larkfield for your eighth Badge.
Eight Badges! Seren is still searching the sky for the Grand Lantern. Get ready for the lantern festival.
The Grand Lantern is under the Paragon pit on Quarry Road.

grey.name: The Grey Wildmon
stages: A Fawnlight in the Bramblewood glade has lost all its colour. Find three Glowcaps in the forest to comfort it. ({glowcap}/3)
Give the Glowcaps to the grey Fawnlight in the glade.
Something is still draining its light. Find the Hollow Order poacher hiding in the north of Bramblewood.
The Siphon Lantern is broken. Go back to the Fawnlight in the glade.

league.name: The Lantern League
stages: Show your Lantern Road Pass at the gate north of Ironmouth, then make your way along Lantern Road.
Reach Lantern Isle at the end of Lantern Road.
Defeat the four Gatekeepers of the Lantern League, in any order, without leaving the Sanctum.
All four gates are open. Face the Champion.

masters.name: The Lantern Masters
stages: The Gatekeepers have become the Lantern Masters. Beat all four, then Kit, then whoever waits behind him.

mirror.name: The Sealed Signal Tower
stages: The Signal Tower in Skyreach has been sealed for years. Turn the mirrors inside so the light reaches the seal.

parcel.name: The Shrine Lanterns
stages: Collect the kindled Lanterns from Keeper Edda at the shrine in Fernwick, north along Route 1.
Bring the Lanterns back to Professor Thorne's lab in Emberlow.

reef.name: The Grey Reef
stages: Find out what is draining the reef off Sunward Shore, south of Coralport.
Tell Ranger Wren at the Coralport Ranger Station what you found.

ruins.name: The Sunken Ruins
stages: Dive at the Saltreach dive point and find what Paragon is doing in the Sunken Ruins.
Bring what you found to Ranger Wren at the Saltreach Ranger Hut.

seaglass.name: Sea Glass for Old Fenn
stages: Find 3 pieces of Sea Glass around Emberlow and Route 1. ({sea_glass}/3)
Give the Sea Glass to Old Fenn on the Emberlow pier.

starfall.name: The Starfall Isles
stages: Professor Thorne has news for the new Champion. Visit the lab in Emberlow.
Take the ferry from Port Calder to the Starfall Isles.
Explore the Starfall Isles. Something golden has been seen on the summit.

teeth.name: Nothing But Teeth
stages: Catch a Nibbit by fishing in the Furrow Lane pond, then show it to Fisher Gil on the jetty.
Raise a Nibbit until it evolves, then show Fisher Gil what it becomes.

trainer.name: A Trainer's First Steps
stages: Catch a Wildmon in Route 1's tall grass. Weaken it, then throw a Lantern from your Bag.
Show Professor Thorne your Wildbook in Emberlow.

training.name: Drill Sergeant
stages: Complete three training drills at the Fernwick Training Ground. ({drills}/3)

wardens.name: The Five Wardens
stages: Find and catch the five Wardens: Solvane at Emberforge, Tidevane in Deepreach, Galevane in a Gullwind storm, Nocthra atop the Drowned Spire and Aurelion on Starfall Peak.

wheels.name: Wheels Wanted
stages: Find three Skate Wheels for Jaz: one up Shalebrook Pass, one in Vantage City and one by the trees. Then bring them to the Vantage skate park.

aegadillo.desc: Its plates are harder than quarried granite. A charging Aegadillo has knocked down stone walls without slowing.
aegadillo.name: Aegadillo

armlet.desc: Rolls itself into a tight stone ball and bowls down hillsides. Quarry workers find them asleep in the gravel heaps every morning.
armlet.habitat: Quarry Road and the Shalebrook quarry
armlet.name: Armlet

ashfoal.desc: A wobbly little foal with a mane of soft embers. It sleeps by the hearth in winter and nobody minds.
ashfoal.habitat: Stockridge pastures and the long grass on Quarry Road
ashfoal.name: Ashfoal

bedrockbore.desc: Its claws are harder than steel. Shalebrook quarrymen follow its tunnels to find the best stone.
bedrockbore.name: Bedrockbore

binrascal.desc: A masked raccoon that raids Vantage bins. It always leaves the lid back on, which is very polite.
binrascal.habitat: Shalebrook Pass and Starfall Road at night, on its way to raid the Vantage bins
binrascal.name: Binrascal

blazeling.desc: A little lizard with a flame for a tail. It chases its own tail in circles, then sulks when it gets too hot to catch.
blazeling.habitat: Born on a farm in Larkfield
blazeling.name: Blazeling

blazestride.desc: It runs on two legs, faster than a galloping horse. The flame on its tail flares brighter the faster it goes.
blazestride.name: Blazestride

bristlehog.desc: Its spines have grown into a thicket of thorny vines. It snuffles out roots and truffles with its broad snout.
bristlehog.name: Bristlehog

bristling.desc: A hedgehog that rolls into a ball of leafy spines when startled. It loves to nap in hedgerows heavy with berries.
bristling.habitat: Born on a farm in Larkfield
bristling.name: Bristling

celestrel.desc: A falcon with wings like the night sky. When it dives, it leaves a streak of light behind it, like a shooting star.
celestrel.name: Celestrel

chirpling.desc: A little green cricket that sings at sunset. Larkfield children try to catch them in jars and always let them go.
chirpling.habitat: Long grass on Furrow Lane and around Larkfield
chirpling.name: Chirpling

cobblecoo.desc: The boss of every city square. A whole flock follows it, and they all strut in step.
cobblecoo.name: Cobblecoo

comette.desc: A tiny falling star that never quite landed. It bobs around telescopes, curious about the people looking up.
comette.habitat: Hilltops around Starfall on clear nights
comette.name: Comette

cooper.desc: A plump city pigeon that will follow you anywhere for a crumb. It knows every bakery in Vantage.
cooper.habitat: Shalebrook Pass and Starfall Road, on its way to the Vantage pavements
cooper.name: Cooper

cumulamb.desc: A great woolly cloud that brings the first snow of winter. Farmers count them in the sky to guess how cold it will be.
cumulamb.name: Cumulamb

dreadfin.desc: Nobody believes a Nibbit could become this. Its fin cutting through the water empties a whole bay in seconds.
dreadfin.name: Dreadfin

echowarden.desc: It guards the deepest caves. Its screech can shake loose a stalactite, so cavers whisper near it.
echowarden.name: Echowarden

fieldfiddle.desc: It plays a tune on its long back legs that makes the wheat sway. Farmers say a good harvest follows its song.
fieldfiddle.name: Fieldfiddle

fogling.desc: A wisp of sea fog with two shy eyes. On calm nights, dozens drift in from the sea together.
fogling.habitat: Foggy nights on Saltreach Key and Sunward Shore
fogling.name: Fogling

fogmantle.desc: A rolling bank of fog with a lantern-bright heart. Lost boats follow its glow home.
fogmantle.name: Fogmantle

fortrab.desc: It carries a whole little castle of stone on its back. Hermit Wildmon move into the towers.
fortrab.name: Fortrab

frostpuff.desc: A fluffy lamb made of snow cloud. It drifts a little off the ground when it is happy.
frostpuff.name: Frostpuff

fulmiray.desc: It glides through stormy seas with lightning dancing along its wings. Fishermen head for shore when they see it leap.
fulmiray.name: Fulmiray

gatormaw.desc: The undisputed king of the rivers. Boats steer wide of the dark water where it rests.
gatormaw.name: Gatormaw

gibbolt.desc: Swings along power cables and steals shiny things from windowsills. It hums when it is up to something.
gibbolt.habitat: Rooftops and power lines around Vantage City
gibbolt.name: Gibbolt

goldkoi.desc: A gold fish with whiskers. Catch a big one and it is said your luck will turn.
goldkoi.habitat: Ponds and slow rivers, mostly the Furrow Pond; prize catch of fishing contests
goldkoi.name: Goldkoi

gritmole.desc: A grumpy little mole with tough claws. It digs so fast it leaves tunnels behind like ant runs.
gritmole.habitat: Quarry Road and Shalebrook Pass, in the gravel
gritmole.name: Gritmole

grotbat.desc: A small bat with huge ears. It finds its way in the dark by humming and listening for echoes.
grotbat.habitat: The Old Shale Mine, roosting upside down
grotbat.name: Grotbat

halcyra.desc: A great bird of gold and green that rose from the light the Grand Lantern gave back. Farmers say a field it flies over will never go grey.
halcyra.habitat: Under the Paragon pit, after the festival, when the night is clear
halcyra.name: Halcyra

hearthoof.desc: A proud horse whose hooves leave little sparks. The ranchers of the Far Reach ride them on the coldest nights.
hearthoof.name: Hearthoof

hedgeboar.desc: A great boar crowned with brambles. When it charges, whole hedges are flattened and spring back greener than before.
hedgeboar.name: Hedgeboar

hexmog.desc: A ghostly cat with eyes like two green lanterns. Nobody has ever seen it arrive. It is simply there.
hexmog.name: Hexmog

hissleaf.desc: A grass snake that hides among the crops. Its green scales make it almost impossible to spot until it hisses.
hissleaf.name: Hissleaf

junkbandit.desc: It wears a bin lid as a shield and steals anything shiny. Vantage police say it has never been caught. Not once.
junkbandit.name: Junkbandit

kilowatt.desc: A slow little tortoise with a battery for a shell. It naps on warm transformers and charges up while it snores.
kilowatt.habitat: Hums near power stations and the Circuit Hall
kilowatt.name: Kilowatt

lensling.desc: A little beetle with a glass lens for a shell. It sits very still on clear nights and gathers starlight until it glows.
lensling.habitat: Starfall Road and the observatory grounds at night
lensling.name: Lensling

megawatt.desc: Its shell stores enough power to light a whole street. When it is angry, the coils on its back glow white hot.
megawatt.name: Megawatt

moltworm.desc: A fat little worm with a glowing tail. Miners keep one in a jar as a nightlight.
moltworm.habitat: The Old Shale Mine, glowing softly in the dark
moltworm.name: Moltworm

nibbit.desc: A tiny, toothless fish that can only nibble. Fishers throw it straight back without a second look.
nibbit.name: Nibbit

novaflare.desc: When it flares, the night sky over Starfall goes bright as day for a moment. Seren keeps a list of every sighting.
novaflare.name: Novaflare

octomind.desc: Its huge head glows when it thinks hard. Divers say it can untie a knot in their air line from across the reef.
octomind.name: Octomind

octorb.desc: A round little octopus that solves puzzles for fun. It unscrews jars, opens shells, and once let itself out of an aquarium.
octorb.habitat: Rock pools around the Sunward Keys
octorb.name: Octorb

orchardian.desc: An old tree that walks the orchards at night, checking every branch. Apples grow sweeter where it has passed.
orchardian.name: Orchardian

packhowl.desc: Leads its pack across the Far Reach by moonlight. Farmers hear the howling and bring the hens inside.
packhowl.name: Packhowl

petalsprite.desc: A flower with a face that turns to follow the sun. Bees adore it and it adores them back.
petalsprite.name: Petalsprite

phantabby.desc: A see-through kitten that purrs in empty rooms. Islanders leave out a saucer of milk so it brings them good luck.
phantabby.name: Phantabby

pincrab.desc: A tiny crab that carries a pebble on its back like a house. It swaps pebbles when it outgrows one.
pincrab.habitat: Rock pools on Sunward Shore and Coralport beach
pincrab.name: Pincrab

pouncerra.desc: It lands every pounce without a sound. Mountain climbers say if you see one, it has already been watching you for an hour.
pouncerra.name: Pouncerra

pyrannox.desc: An ancient king of fire and stone. Its footsteps leave glowing prints that smoulder for days.
pyrannox.name: Pyrannox

radiwurm.desc: Its glowing body lights whole tunnels. Lost cavers follow the glow and always find the way out.
radiwurm.name: Radiwurm

refractor.desc: Its prism shell splits light into rainbows. The observatory keeps one on the roof to point the big telescope at the brightest stars.
refractor.name: Refractor

regalfin.desc: Its long fins shine like silk in the sun. Fishing contests have been won and lost over one Regalfin.
regalfin.name: Regalfin

ribbonel.desc: A ribbon-thin eel that hides in kelp and sways with it. Its stripes warn every fish to keep its distance.
ribbonel.habitat: Kelp beds around Saltreach Key and the Sunken Ruins
ribbonel.name: Ribbonel

rumblehide.desc: Stamps so hard the mud splashes clean over the treetops. Its wide jaw can crack a boulder in one bite.
rumblehide.name: Rumblehide

scarecrown.desc: It stands guard over the harvest all night with a lantern glowing inside its chest. Farmers leave it a fresh straw hat every autumn.
scarecrown.name: Scarecrown

seedsprout.desc: A seed that woke up early. It sometimes turns up in a garden bed that has been watered every day.
seedsprout.habitat: Now and then on Furrow Lane, and in gardens that are well looked after
seedsprout.name: Seedsprout

skimray.desc: A flat little stingray that buries itself in warm sand. Step on one and you will get a fizzy little zap.
skimray.habitat: Shallow sandy water on Sunward Shore
skimray.name: Skimray

slithersea.desc: A great sea serpent that coils around shipwrecks. Old sailors swear one once tied a whole ferry in a knot.
slithersea.name: Slithersea

sloshum.desc: Spends all day sunk in warm mud with only its nose showing. It sneezes mud at anyone who wakes it.
sloshum.name: Sloshum

snapling.desc: A baby crocodile that bites everything once, just to check. It falls asleep floating in the duck pond.
snapling.habitat: Born on a farm in Larkfield
snapling.name: Snapling

snaptooth.desc: It lies perfectly still in the shallows for hours. Only its eyes show above the water, watching.
snaptooth.name: Snaptooth

stampede.desc: A mountain of muscle and shaggy fur. When a herd of Stampede runs, the ground shakes for miles.
stampede.name: Stampede

starquill.desc: A tiny bird whose tail feathers end in little stars. Wish on the first Starquill you see at night and it is said to come true.
starquill.habitat: Hilltops around Starfall, mostly after dark
starquill.name: Starquill

steerling.desc: A stubborn calf with a woolly mane. It follows the ranch hands everywhere, head-butting anyone who stops for a chat.
steerling.habitat: Stockridge ranch, and now and then wandering on Quarry Road
steerling.name: Steerling

strawkin.desc: A little bundle of straw that came to life when a lantern was left burning in the field all night. It scares crows, then feels bad and says sorry.
strawkin.habitat: Furrow Lane on dark nights, close to the Larkfield wheat
strawkin.name: Strawkin

surgibbon.desc: Its long arms crackle with stored power. A troop of Surgibbon once blacked out half of Vantage City for fun.
surgibbon.name: Surgibbon

tuftfang.desc: A lynx kitten with tufted ears that twitch at the faintest sound. It stalks shadows on the rocks for practice.
tuftfang.name: Tuftfang

vinestrike.desc: It spreads a hood of leaves and sways before it strikes. Even Packhowl give it a wide berth.
vinestrike.name: Vinestrike

yipper.desc: Wild pups that roam the farmland in noisy little gangs. One yip, and the whole gang comes running.
yipper.name: Yipper

zappy.desc: A fluffy kit that can only make tiny sparks. It evolves when it trusts its trainer completely.
zappy.name: Zappy

trades.say: My Steerling eats all the bread! Swap it for a Yipper? A Yipper would guard the bakery.
An Armlet would roll the rubble away for me. Trade you my Gritmole, Digby. He is a terrible digger.
I need a Gibbolt for my study of shiny things. Trade for my Binrascal, Bandit? He keeps eating my notes.
I want a Rooftik like my big brother! I will swap my shiny Cooper, Sir Coo. He is very fancy.
Skimray are the best surfing buddies. Trade me one? My Pincrab, Shelly, would love a new beach.
We study kelp eels. Got a Ribbonel? I will give you Wisp the Fogling. It followed me home.
A Hootlet would keep me company on night watch. I will trade you Twinkle, a Comette. It is very bright. Too bright, sometimes.
I want a Chirpling that sings! Trade you Sprout? Sprout does not sing. Sprout just sits.
A Goatlet could carry my pack up Lumen Climb. I will swap you Cinders, my Ashfoal. She keeps setting fire to my tent.
I have always wanted a Celestrel. Trade you Nimbus, my Frostpuff? It sneezes snow.

ada.intro: Shh! You will scare the Starquill. Oh, never mind, let us battle.
ada.name: Ada

alun.intro: Forty years I have watched over Larkfield's flocks. Let us see how you watch over yours.
alun.name: Alun

ash.intro: Up here the wind tests you. So do I!
ash.name: Ash

bert.intro: Break's over! Let's crack on with a battle!
bert.name: Bert

bess.intro: Your dad said you would come home one day. He did NOT say you would get so tall!
bess.name: Bess

bo.intro: The road was shut for weeks! Finally I can climb up to Starfall again.
bo.name: Bo

cadet_a.intro: Intruder! This is a restricted training area!
cadet_a.name: Brio

cadet_b.intro: You do not have clearance! Silver Lanterns, go!
cadet_b.name: Tamsin

corin.intro: I watched {legend} climb this road five years ago. You have the same look in your eye.
corin.name: Corin

dale.intro: Yee-haw! Nobody gets to the boss without going through me first!
dale.name: Dale

diver1.intro: This pier is closed for Paragon research!
diver1.name: Fenn

diver2.intro: Turn back! The reef belongs to Paragon now!
diver2.name: Isla

fenn.intro: Paragon is finished. So what? I can still beat YOU!
fenn.name: Fenn

greta.intro: No shortcuts in this quarry! Battle me or turn back!
greta.name: Greta

halley.intro: Nearly at the top! But first, the laws of physics. And me.
halley.name: Halley

hob.intro: Petra says a good trainer thinks before they push. Let us see you think!
hob.name: Hob

hq_c1.intro: This floor is members only! Where is your silver Lantern?
hq_c1.name: Juno

hq_c2.intro: You beat me in the Training Wing. Not this time!
hq_c2.name: Rufus

hq_c3.intro: Halt! The lift is for the Founder's guests only!
hq_c3.name: Nova

jo.intro: You've got grit, getting this far. Let's see if your partner has it too!
jo.name: Jo

jonah.intro: I have been training on this mountain for a year. Let us see who wants it more.
jonah.name: Jonah

kahu.intro: Surf is flat, so let us battle instead!
kahu.name: Kahu

kai.intro: Whoa, dude! Battle before I bomb the hill?
kai.name: Kai

lena.intro: My Sloshum loves the mud by the pond. Want to see it splash?
lena.name: Lena

lou.intro: Found anything good on the sand? I found a battle!
lou.name: Lou

medium_a.intro: The spirits told me you were coming...
medium_a.name: Ondine

medium_b.intro: Boo! Did I scare you? Battle me anyway!
medium_b.name: Ebb

mira.intro: Eight Badges, and you still have to climb the mountain. Everyone does. Battle me!
mira.name: Mira

moss.intro: Up and down these hills every day! My legs are made of stone, and so are my Wildmon!
moss.name: Moss

nova.intro: A wild trainer! Watch how a Paragon cadet battles!
nova.name: Nova

orion.intro: Pink pad? Bad luck! This room goes nowhere. Except into a battle!
orion.name: Orion

pia.intro: Ramps go one way, rider. Pick the right one!
pia.name: Pia

poppy.intro: Careful where you step! There's a Hissleaf in every furrow. Mine included!
poppy.name: Poppy

reef1.intro: The currents in here will spin you right round!
reef1.name: Moana

reef2.intro: Bet you get lost in the currents!
reef2.name: Tavi

rio.intro: You found a way through the ramps? Respect. Now battle me!
rio.name: Rio

rory.intro: Oi! You there! My Yippers have been chasing crows all morning. Fancy a battle?
rory.name: Rory

ruth.intro: Forty years walking this pass. Let us see what you are made of!
ruth.name: Ruth

silas.intro: This pit belongs to Paragon Academy. Trespassers get a free demonstration of Paragon training!
silas.name: Silas

sparks.intro: Mind the gates! And mind me!
sparks.name: Sparks

vega.intro: Found the gold pad, did you? Then you have found me!
vega.name: Vega

volta.intro: The boss is back, and so are we!
volta.name: Volta

blaze.desc: Fire moves hit 50% harder when HP is below a third.
blaze.name: Flare Up

floating.desc: Drifts above the ground. Immune to Earth moves.
floating.name: Floating

glare.desc: Lowers the foe's Attack when it enters battle.
glare.name: Glare

grit.desc: Attack rises by 50% while it has a status condition. Burns do not weaken it.
grit.name: Grit

kindling.desc: Mastery Trait. The first Fire move it uses in each battle has 30% more power.
kindling.name: Kindling

kindling_heart.desc: Absorbs Fire moves, which then power up its own Fire moves.
kindling_heart.name: Kindling Heart

night_eyes.desc: Dark moves hit 20% harder at night.
night_eyes.name: Night Eyes

old_growth.desc: Mastery Trait. Restores 1/16 of its HP at the end of every turn.
old_growth.name: Old Growth

overgrowth.desc: Grass moves hit 50% harder when HP is below a third.
overgrowth.name: Wild Bloom

pack.desc: Attack rises by 50% in double battles when fighting beside one of its own kind.
pack.name: Pack Hunter

pickup.desc: Sometimes picks up an item after battle if it is not holding one.
pickup.name: Forager

riptide.desc: Mastery Trait. Each foe it knocks out raises its Attack.
riptide.name: Riptide

shed_skin.desc: May shed a status condition at the end of each turn.
shed_skin.name: Molt

shell_armor.desc: A hard shell. Cannot be hit by clean strikes.
shell_armor.name: Hard Shell

static.desc: Contact with it may paralyse the attacker.
static.name: Charged Coat

sturdy.desc: Survives a knockout blow with 1 HP when at full health.
sturdy.name: Steadfast

thick_fur.desc: Takes half damage from Fire and Ice moves.
thick_fur.name: Thick Fur

torrent.desc: Water moves hit 50% harder when HP is below a third.
torrent.name: Undertow

toxic_touch.desc: Contact with it may poison the attacker.
toxic_touch.name: Toxic Touch

cards.desc: Turn over two cards at a time and find all eight pairs of Wildmon. Fewer turns earn a better trophy.
cards.name: Lantern Cards

fishing.desc: Five casts. Press A when the float is in the green to hook a fish. Land all five for Gold.
fishing.name: Coralport Fishing Contest

gauntlet.desc: Beat three quarry crews in a row with no healing in between. Keep your whole team standing for Gold.
gauntlet.name: Quarry Gauntlet

lights.desc: Light all 25 lanterns. Each press flips a lantern and its four neighbours. Match the fewest presses for Gold.
lights.name: Lantern Lights

race.desc: Ride through all five flags on Starfall Road as fast as you can. You need a Bike.
race.name: Starfall Bike Race

roundup.desc: Nudge three runaway Steerling back into their hay pens. Fewer pushes earn a better trophy.
roundup.name: Stockridge Round-Up

skate.desc: Grab all six rings in the skate park as fast as you can. You need a skateboard.
skate.name: Vantage Skate Trial
